image_description: A medium shot of a live musical performance on an outdoor stage. The central subject is a male musician with long blonde hair, wearing a maroon t-shirt and jeans, sitting on a stool and playing an acoustic-electric guitar. To his right stands another male musician in a white t-shirt playing an acoustic guitar. In the background to the left, a female musician in a purple top is partially visible holding a microphone stand. The background features dark stage draping and equipment cases.
